title: Conflicting CRC32 and FNV-1a short-address DAD algorithms in link spec
description: Correctness review: spec/02-physical-link.md defines two normative Section 4.5 DAD algorithms. Lines 185-216 derive short addresses with crc32_ieee and a truncated ASCII-LICHEN initializer; lines 425-449 instead derive them with FNV-1a32 basis 0x811C9DC5 and explicitly say the earlier hash_32 notation is wrong. Line 67 also points DAD to CRC32. Peers following the two definitions choose different 16-bit addresses and retry sequences, breaking deterministic interop and test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json. Remove the stale definition and retain one exact algorithm.
